messages:
incident-bot: Heads up: degraded latency observed for hosted inference in us-east-1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Impact: ~4-7% of requests (higher for >6k token contexts). Possible elevated p99 and intermittent 5xxs. Live incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1698004321 :warning:

jordan: looking at traces now. grpc timeouts from ingress -> runtime fanout. initial diffs point to a kernel version landed last night (kernel v3.12) on a subset of workers. I'm seeing kernel execution stalls and repeated retries. sample: 
```
WARN kernel: execution stalled (120s) pid=wm-xx-221
ERR runtime: failed call: retried 3 times
```

tess: pausing kernel v3.12 rollout across us-east. rolling back 15% of workers to v3.11 to validate. will follow up with metrics in 3m.

omar: started rollback: `platformctl rollback --region us-east --component kernel --target v3.11 --percent 15`

jordan: graphs: p99 went from 1.8s -> 3.6s for long-context traffic, errors spiking on affected hosts. see dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ops/hosted-latency?from=now-30m&to=now

tess: mitigation checklist executed:
- paused rollout (v3.12)
- rollback 15% -> 60% underway to v3.11
- increased tail cache TTL for long sessions to reduce eviction churn
- temporarily lowered per-worker concurrency cap by 20%

lia: customer comms draft ready for affected tenants. short template: 
"We are investigating increased latency for long-context requests in us-east-1. We have applied a rollback and mitigations; we'll update when fully resolved.
" Planning to send in 10m. Tagging tenants with large daily tokens.

customer-support: please queue tiered notices. flag enterprise tenants for direct outreach.

jordan: rollback on initial canary showed p99 improvement within 2m. expanding rollback to 60% now. error count back to baseline on rolled-back nodes.

omar: collecting flamegraphs and kernel logs from affected hosts to /incidents/1698004321/artifacts. request traces archived to S3: s3://incidents/1698004321/traces

tess: next steps: finish rollback to 100% if stability holds for 10m, run a constrained reintroduce of v3.12 with lower concurrency and enhanced kernel logging. create postmortem ticket and add an automated rollback trigger when kernel error rate >0.4% over 2m.

jordan: monitoring: p95/p99 trending down on dashboards. continuing to watch 10m after full rollback.

incident-bot: Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1698004321 (updates and runbook). Broadcast to #customers-facing scheduled once we hit stable baseline.

lia: will send the customer note after we confirm stability for 10m. support team standing by for replies.

jordan: if you see a recurrence, please tag `@oncall` and append logs to the incident artifacts. closing update to follow. :white_check_mark:
